$description: Border tokens - Width and style definitions

_comments.width: Border thickness for different visual emphasis levels
_comments.style: Line styles for different design purposes

width.thin: For subtle dividers and discrete outlines (e.g., separators)
width.base: Standard outline for most components (e.g., cards, inputs)
width.thick: For maximum emphasis (e.g., primary buttons, critical alerts)

style.solid: Standard style for most use cases
style.dashed: For interactive elements or drop areas (e.g., upload)
style.dotted: To indicate focused states or decorative elements
style.double: For special visual effects or emphasis
